text:
Sorry the replacement didn't make it. Yes, you may be eligible for one more. A replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee from its delivery, so if it died within that window despite reasonable care, you can claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back.

The plant sent as this second replacement won't have a guarantee. If you'd like, a Plant Care Specialist can also give you free care advice by chat or email.
